title: Lovely Dense Turkish Pappardelle Pasta
description: A charred, dense, and romantic Turkish dish featuring pappardelle pasta, this recipe is perfect for a special occasion, and is low-sodium-friendly.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until it is charred and caramelized, stirring occasionally.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the ground lamb to the skillet, breaking it up with a whisk as it cooks, until it is no longer pink.
Stir in the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked pappardelle pasta to the skillet, tossing it with the lamb and onion mixture until the pasta is well coated.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley and lemon juice, and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
